title: Google Wallet Finally Arrives on iPhone! 📱
body: Google Wallet Finally Arrives on iPhone! 📱
Google has launched the Google Wallet app for iPhone users in the US: your cards, tickets, and boarding passes all in one place — and designed to work with AI agents for purchases.
Note: tap-to-pay is not yet available in this version.
Would you like it to come to your country? 🌍
